Crawler: a lean low-slung amphibious quadruped with long wiry forelimbs, splayed webbed clawed digits, powerful folded hind legs, narrow salamander-like head, slick mottled peat-green hide and sparse strands of moss. Built for fast melee pursuit. Resting quietly on all four limbs, not lunging, all limbs legible.

Lurker: tall gaunt semi-humanoid amphibious reed ambusher, narrow hunched shoulders, long legs, elongated hands hanging relaxed, tapered fishlike head, natural reedlike dorsal growths and trailing algae breaking its silhouette, mottled olive and muddy brown skin. Standing still in a relaxed slight crouch, arms lowered, not attacking.

Spitter: squat heavy amphibious swamp creature on four sturdy short legs, enormous closed toadlike mouth, conspicuous swollen ochre throat sac and clustered glandular sacs along its shoulders, mottled dark olive skin. Neutral restful stance, mouth closed, no spit or projectiles, silhouette clearly distinct from a lean crawler.

Grasper: a rangy bipedal amphibious horror with disproportionately long muscular forearms and huge grasping webbed hands, hooklike fingers, narrow torso, broad planted feet and a small eyeless-looking fishlike head with tiny recessed eyes. Sinewy rootlike tendons, muted blue-green skin and peat stains. Standing at rest with arms hanging loosely slightly away from the torso, fingers gently curved, both hands completely visible. No attack or extended reaching.

Old Thing elite: an ancient massive swamp amphibian, hulking broad-shouldered biped with thick weight-bearing legs, enormous forearms, hunched upper back with weathered barklike scutes, moss and small shelf fungi, sunken amber eyes beneath a heavy ridged brow, broad catfishlike mouth with short barbels. A territorial elder with monumental weight, asymmetry and age, muted peat greens and stone browns. Quiet resting stance, hands lowered, neither roaring nor attacking.
